description: IGSU, Moldova's General Inspectorate for Emergency Situations, runs the country's fire, rescue and civil protection services and publishes their statistics. The statistical data page, filterable by year from 2009 to 2026, holds monthly statistical files, the latest for August 2026, and multi-year analyses of fires and of exceptional situations from 2010 to 2025, including the number of deaths, material damage and property saved. Older files give fire causes and the districts most affected by fires. Coverage is national, with district detail in some tables. The files are free and available to download as PDF from the IGSU site; no licence terms are stated. Caveats: data are in PDF tables in Romanian and must be transcribed, and categories of exceptional situations are defined by Moldovan regulation. Simulation uses: calibrating the base rate of fires and emergencies by district, sizing fire and rescue capacity, and tracking losses from floods, storms and other events for resilience indicators. Related records: the CTIF world fire statistics (data-ctif-world-fire-statistics) give international comparisons, and Azerbaijan's FHN statistics (data-fhn-azerbaijan-emergency-statistics) are a comparable national source.
